entries.subject: DAMIT 1864: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1864.txt. Model 1864, version 2018-02-19, pole (139°, -45°), period 13.62523 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 94 ±5 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.
